```{python}
#| include: false
import pandas as pd
import plotly.graph_objects as go

INK, MUTED, GRID = "#0b0b0b", "#52514e", "#e6e5e1"
BLUE, ORANGE = "#2a78d6", "#eb6834"
# one colour per attraction, fixed so a series never changes colour
ENTITY = {
    "British Museum": "#2a78d6",
    "National Gallery": "#eb6834",
    "Natural History Museum": "#1baf7a",
    "Tate Modern": "#eda100",
    "Tower of London": "#e87ba4",
}
BASE = dict(
    font=dict(family="system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif", size=13, color=MUTED),
    plot_bgcolor="rgba(0,0,0,0)",
    paper_bgcolor="rgba(0,0,0,0)",
    hoverlabel=dict(bgcolor="white", font_color=INK, bordercolor=GRID),
)

attractions = pd.read_csv("data/attractions.csv")
visits = pd.read_csv("data/visits.csv")

def short(name):
    return name.split(" (")[0].removeprefix("The ")

attractions["name"] = attractions["attraction"].map(short)
attractions["free"] = attractions["admission"].str.startswith("Free")
top = attractions.loc[attractions["visits_2025"].idxmax()]
total_visits = attractions["visits_2025"].sum()
free_count = int(attractions["free"].sum())

pivot = visits.pivot(index="attraction", columns="year", values="visits")
change = ((pivot[2025] / pivot[2019] - 1) * 100).sort_values()
```

## Row {height=42%}

```{python}
#| title: "Most-visited London attractions, 2025"
ranked = attractions.sort_values("visits_2025")
fig = go.Figure(layout=dict(
    **BASE,
    barmode="overlay",
    bargap=0.35,
    xaxis=dict(range=[0, 8.4], showgrid=True, gridcolor=GRID, zeroline=False,
               title="Visits (millions)", ticksuffix="M"),
    yaxis=dict(automargin=True, categoryorder="array", categoryarray=list(ranked["name"])),
    legend=dict(orientation="h", x=1, xanchor="right", y=1.02, yanchor="bottom", entrywidth=120),
    margin=dict(l=10, r=10, t=40, b=10),
))
for is_free, label, color in [(True, "Free entry", BLUE), (False, "Paid or other", ORANGE)]:
    d = ranked[ranked["free"] == is_free]
    _ = fig.add_bar(
        x=d["visits_2025"] / 1e6,
        y=d["name"],
        orientation="h",
        name=label,
        marker_color=color,
        hovertemplate="%{y}<br>%{x:.2f}M visits<extra>" + label + "</extra>",
    )
for _, r in ranked.iterrows():
    _ = fig.add_annotation(x=r["visits_2025"] / 1e6, y=r["name"], text=f"{r['visits_2025'] / 1e6:.1f}M",
                           showarrow=False, xanchor="left", xshift=6, font=dict(color=INK, size=12))
fig
```

```{python}
#| title: "Visits by year, 2015–2025"
fig = go.Figure(layout=dict(
    **BASE,
    xaxis=dict(dtick=1, showgrid=False, range=[2014.7, 2026.9]),
    yaxis=dict(title="Visits (millions)", rangemode="tozero", showgrid=True,
               gridcolor=GRID, zeroline=False),
    legend=dict(orientation="h", y=-0.2, entrywidth=175),
    hovermode="x unified",
    margin=dict(l=10, r=10, t=10, b=10),
    shapes=[dict(type="rect", xref="x", yref="paper", x0=2019.6, x1=2021.4, y0=0, y1=1,
                 fillcolor="rgba(120,120,110,0.10)", line_width=0, layer="below")],
    annotations=[dict(x=2020.5, y=1, yref="paper", text="COVID-19", showarrow=False,
                      font=dict(size=11, color=MUTED), yanchor="top")],
))
for name, color in ENTITY.items():
    g = visits[visits["attraction"] == name].sort_values("year")
    _ = fig.add_scatter(
        x=g["year"], y=g["visits"] / 1e6, name=name, mode="lines+markers",
        line=dict(color=color, width=2),
        marker=dict(size=8, color=color, line=dict(color="white", width=2)),
        hovertemplate="%{y:.2f}M",
    )
# end-of-line labels, pushed apart so they never overlap
ends = sorted(((visits[(visits["attraction"] == n) & (visits["year"] == 2025)]["visits"].iloc[0] / 1e6, n) for n in ENTITY), reverse=True)
ypos, prev = {}, None
for val, n in ends:
    ypos[n] = val if prev is None else min(val, prev - 0.55)
    prev = ypos[n]
for n in ENTITY:
    _ = fig.add_annotation(x=2025, y=ypos[n], text=n.replace("Natural History Museum", "Natural History"),
                           showarrow=False, xanchor="left", xshift=8, font=dict(size=11, color=INK))
fig
```

## Row {height=36%}

```{python}
#| title: "Recovery: 2025 visits vs 2019 (pre-COVID)"
#| footer: "Natural History Museum counts include its gardens from 2024, so its rise is not like-for-like. Source: ALVA."
fig = go.Figure(
    go.Bar(
        x=change.index,
        y=change.values,
        marker_color=[BLUE if v >= 0 else ORANGE for v in change.values],
        hovertemplate="%{x}<br>%{y:+.1f}% vs 2019<extra></extra>",
    ),
    layout=dict(
        **BASE,
        bargap=0.5,
        xaxis=dict(showgrid=False, zeroline=False),
        yaxis=dict(title="Change since 2019", ticksuffix="%", range=[-42, 42],
                   showgrid=True, gridcolor=GRID, zeroline=True, zerolinecolor=MUTED),
        margin=dict(l=10, r=10, t=10, b=10),
    ),
)
for n, v in change.items():
    _ = fig.add_annotation(x=n, y=v, text=f"{v:+.0f}%", showarrow=False, yshift=12 if v >= 0 else -12,
                           font=dict(color=INK, size=13))
fig
```
